children: AtlasClear Holdings, Inc. reported fiscal 2026 revenue of $20.05M, up 85% from $10.86M a year earlier, while net income fell to $1.96M from $5.75M and diluted earnings per share declined to $0.02 from $0.96— results disclosed in the company's 10-K filing.
Revenue was $20.05M for FY 2026, compared with $10.86M in FY 2025; YoY change 85%.
Net income was $1.96M for FY 2026, compared with $5.75M in FY 2025; change (65.9%).
Diluted earnings per share was $0.02 for FY 2026, compared with $0.96 in FY 2025; change (97.9%).
Revenue growth was driven by higher commissions and the launch and rapid scale-up of stock locate services, creating a significant new revenue stream.
The company hired additional employees and executives to support expanded trading, clearing and locate operations as it scales operations.
AtlasClear continued building fintech B2B prime banking and prime brokerage capabilities targeting sub-$1B financial firms.
Management executed a Purchase Agreement to acquire Commercial Bancorp to integrate banking capabilities; the transaction remains subject to regulatory approvals.
